caption: The drawing consists of a square textile piece with a wide, dark purple border featuring diagonal lines and a cream inner border decorated with a red zigzag stitch pattern. Inside the central panel, a young person wearing a red head covering and scarf, green dress, red stockings, and black boots stands on a snowy landscape. The person is holding an object with blue and brown elements in their right hand. Around them, there are two brown houses with white, snow-covered roofs; one is positioned on the left side behind a white tree with brown branches, and the other is near a large tree with a thick brown trunk and dense blue and white foliage to the right. Below the person and to the left is a low bush with dark green and blue leaves. The background contains various white and gray horizontal lines indicating snow and winter weather. The design is stitched on a light-colored base fabric.
title: Applique Coverlet (Detail)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
